summary_points: Document title: HTF & Molten Salts Hydraulic Circuits Calculation Report
Prepared by Antonia Gómez Gómez and Pedro Moreira Gomes
Reviewed by Jesús Manuel Jimenez García
Document is protected against unauthorized reproduction and distribution
Ten HTF Far Field Pumps with a suction pressure of 172 psia.
Twelve pressure regulating valves at the pumps' discharge.
Assumptions include pipe details, temperatures, and pump performance curves.
Simulation results show issues for case 2 when the tank is at its minimum level.
Heat exchanger inlet and outlet nozzle heights are specified for different modes.
Simulation results showed no issues with existing pumps and heat exchangers.
New set of heat exchangers and installed pumps can handle all operation cases.
Pumps can run below maximum speed (1132 rpm) and control valves at more than 50% opening.
